answer: Lay the whole record out as a mesa: a flat, fully exposed plateau where every claim is published in the open, so nothing can be filed out of sight and no head may keep a private ledger that peers cannot inspect. A raven is then drawn by epoch randomness to roam that mesa and peck at entries chosen without warning, and its findings are posted for everyone to check. Standing shows as a terrace of stepped visibility: the higher your tier, the more of your history must stay exposed, so a farm hiding its links cannot climb while honest heads gain from the light.
